notes: BLS QCEW Open Data API, sum of NAICS 3341+3342+3344+3345+3364, private ownership, METRO AREA (New York-Newark-Jersey City, NY-NJ MSA, area C3562) -- NOT city-proper. A true 5-borough sum is never achievable for this combined basket in any year -- the niche codes have too few establishments in the outer boroughs. A narrower, city-scoped alternative exists: NAICS 3364 (Aerospace) alone is borough-complete 2015-2022 (all establishments in Queens; the other 4 boroughs genuinely have none) if a scope-accurate but narrower series is preferred.
